title: effects_subsystem_test: wall-clock backoff interval assertions and leaked allocations (13 blocks)
symptom: 13 test blocks in tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig fail under `zig build test-integration-svc` on a freshly migrated database. TC-EXP-301-05 fails at effects_subsystem_test.zig:699 `try testing.expect(observed_delta_ms >= lower_bound)`. TC-EXP-301-07 and siblings additionally report `leaked 2 allocations` originating in Allocator.dupe.
root_cause_analysis: Two distinct defects in the same file. (1) The backoff-schedule tests assert on measured wall-clock deltas between outbox attempts, which is not a stable property when roughly 20 test binaries contend for the same database and the host is loaded. (2) Several HTTP-adapter tests dupe header strings without a matching free, so the DebugAllocator reports leaks and fails the block. Neither is related to tenant provisioning or to the schema_migrations symptom described in ISS-0150.
impact: 13 of the 86 remaining failures in test-integration-svc. Blocks the suite from exiting 0.
acceptance_criteria: TC-EXP-301-05 and the other backoff tests assert on a deterministic property (recorded next_attempt_at ordering) rather than on measured wall-clock deltas
Every allocation in the HTTP adapter tests has a matching defer free; the suite reports 0 leaks for this file
zig build test-integration-svc shows 0 failures attributed to effects_subsystem_test.zig
related: ISS-0150 / GH #482 - the run that surfaced this
notes: Filed per CLAUDE.md 'No Issue Left Local-Only' and the 'filed and forwarded, not fixed here' scope boundary. ISS-0150 fixed 3 root causes (33 blocks) with zero regressions; this cluster has a distinct root cause and belongs in its own run.
resolution: De-duplicated against ISS-0158 / GH #479 during run WF03-ISS-0158-20260807. Both were filed against the same 13 failing blocks of tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig. The leak half of this issue was fixed under ISS-0158 (though the leaks were in production source - src/effects/worker.zig deliverSpec and four paths in src/engine/transition.zig - plus the test file's drifted hand-copies of the engine teardown helpers, NOT in the HTTP adapter tests as stated here). The wall-clock backoff half remains open and was carried forward as ISS-0186 / GH #520 so closing this does not lose it. GitHub issue #515 closed with an explanatory comment.
